# Sentinely MCP tools

<!-- Generated from the Sentinely server's tool registry. Do not edit. -->

The remote endpoint `https://app.sentinely.co/api/mcp` lists 33 tools: 22 reads and 11 writes. Every call is scoped to the workspace chosen during OAuth, and writes need a role that can make the same change in the dashboard. "Confirm first" tools return a preview and a `confirmToken` and change nothing until they are called again with that token.

No tool changes billing, API keys, members or invites, CRM or account connections, or deletes a workspace. No tool browses a site on demand or submits a takedown.

## Reads

- `search_signals` (read): Returns signals Sentinely has already detected for your workspace, newest first. It does not fetch or browse any site.
- `search_cases` (read): Returns brand-protection cases Sentinely has already detected for your workspace, highest severity first. It does not fetch or browse any site.
- `get_case` (read): Returns one case Sentinely has already detected, with its brand, an evidence summary and recent notes. Evidence object keys are never returned. It does not fetch or browse any site.
- `get_monthly_report` (read): Returns the monthly summary of cases Sentinely has already detected for your workspace, with turnaround times. The month is YYYY-MM in UTC and defaults to the current month. It does not fetch or browse any site.
- `get_removal_options` (read): Read current official reporting and removal routes for a surface and threat. This never submits a report.
- `draft_removal_request` (cases:read): Drafts a takedown request for a brand protection case on an official platform route, with the evidence pack it cites (captures with timestamps and content hashes), for a person to review and submit. Nothing is saved or sent: it cannot attest, sign, submit or guarantee removal.
- `search_mentions` (listening:read): Searches the public mentions Sentinely collected for your tracked topics (AI social listening), with the AI relevance verdict, intent, sentiment, matched topics and reasons. Filters match the Mentions inbox. It does not fetch or browse any site.
- `get_mention` (listening:read): Returns one collected mention with its full text, author, the AI relevance verdict and reasons, matched topics, and similar mentions. It does not fetch or browse any site.
- `listening_overview` (listening:read): Summarizes AI social listening for a project, as on the Overview page: mention volume and sentiment mix for the past 7 days, emerging topics with their spike series, open cases, capture health and live sources. It does not fetch or browse any site.
- `listening_analytics` (listening:read): Returns listening analytics for a project and period, as on the Analytics page: collected and qualified volume, daily trend, share of voice across your tracked topics, platform, sentiment and intent breakdowns, and case counts by threat. Dates are ISO 8601; the default period is the past 30 days. It does not fetch or browse any site.
- `list_topics` (listening:read): Lists the topics (keywords) Sentinely listens for in a project, as on the Keywords page: whether each is active, which platforms it covers, its include and exclude terms, and how many mentions it matched in the past 30 days.
- `list_feeds` (listening:read): Lists the saved mention feeds (filtered views) in a project, as on the Feeds page.
- `get_feed` (listening:read): Returns one saved mention feed and its filters. Use search_mentions to read the mentions it shows.
- `source_health` (listening:read): Shows which platforms Sentinely is listening on for your workspace: each source and its health, plus per-platform coverage with mentions collected in the past 7 days.
- `list_competitors` (competitors:read): Lists the competitors your workspace tracks: competitors named in revenue signal setup (with aliases, products and domains) and competitor pages watched for pricing, launch and positioning changes.
- `competitor_changes` (competitors:read): Returns recent changes Sentinely detected on watched competitor pages (pricing, launches, positioning), newest first, with the lines added and removed. It does not fetch or browse any site.
- `search_revenue_signals` (signals:read): Searches revenue signals: public posts where someone shows buying intent, asks for alternatives or complains about a competitor. Tabs and filters match the Revenue signals inbox; the default tab is needs_review. It does not fetch or browse any site.
- `get_revenue_signal` (signals:read): Returns one revenue signal with the source post, why Sentinely flagged it, the matched account and competitor, and its review history. It does not fetch or browse any site.
- `revenue_pipeline` (signals:read): Summarizes the revenue signal pipeline, as on the Pipeline page: signals found and accepted, and recorded opportunities and won value by attribution.
- `list_accounts` (signals:read): Lists the companies (accounts) behind your revenue signals, most signals first, as on the Accounts page, with accepted counts and the competitors they mention.
- `list_captures` (cases:read): Lists evidence captures that failed in the past 24 hours, as on the Captures page, each with a safe failure category (never the raw provider error).
- `get_report` (cases:read): Returns the brand protection report, as on the Reports page: cases identified, by status, threat and platform, escalations, resolutions and turnaround. Give a month (YYYY-MM, UTC) or a custom period with since and until (ISO 8601, up to 366 days). The default is the current month.

## Writes

- `create_case` (cases:write): Opens a case for a signal Sentinely has already detected in your workspace. If the signal already has a case, returns it unchanged. It never edits, resolves or removes anything. idempotencyKey is any unique string you choose per action; retrying with the same key never repeats the write.
- `annotate_case` (cases:write): Adds a note to a case in your workspace. Notes are appended; it never edits or removes existing notes or the case. idempotencyKey is any unique string you choose per action; retrying with the same key never repeats the write.
- `create_topic` (topics:write, confirm first): Starts listening for a new topic (keyword) in a project, optionally limited to some platforms. Changes that can raise collection return a cost estimate and a confirmToken first; nothing changes until you call again with that token. idempotencyKey is any unique string you choose per action; retrying with the same key never repeats the write.
- `update_topic` (topics:write, confirm first): Changes how a tracked topic is collected: platforms, include and exclude terms, exact matching, or resumes a paused topic. Changes that can raise collection return a cost estimate and a confirmToken first; nothing changes until you call again with that token. Narrowing a topic (exclude terms, exact match) runs at once. idempotencyKey is any unique string you choose per action; retrying with the same key never repeats the write.
- `pause_topic` (topics:write): Stops collecting new mentions for a topic. Mentions already collected stay; resume it later with update_topic. idempotencyKey is any unique string you choose per action; retrying with the same key never repeats the write.
- `label_mention` (listening:write): Records your judgement on a collected mention: whether it is relevant to you, and a corrected sentiment with its category. Labels tune the AI relevance check; earlier labels stay in the history. idempotencyKey is any unique string you choose per action; retrying with the same key never repeats the write.
- `review_revenue_signal` (signals:write): Records a review decision on a revenue signal: accept, reject (with a reason), mark unsure, assign to an owner, dismiss, or reopen. idempotencyKey is any unique string you choose per action; retrying with the same key never repeats the write.
- `route_signal` (signals:write, confirm first, reaches an outside service): Sends an accepted revenue signal to the CRM already connected to your workspace (HubSpot): creates a deal, or attaches the signal as a note to a company or deal. The first call returns a preview and a confirmToken; nothing is sent until you call again with it. It never connects or changes the CRM connection. idempotencyKey is any unique string you choose per action; retrying with the same key never repeats the write.
- `add_competitor` (competitors:write, reaches an outside service): Adds a public competitor page (pricing, launches or positioning) to your watchlist; Sentinely checks it and reports changes. Uses one page from your watchlist allowance. idempotencyKey is any unique string you choose per action; retrying with the same key never repeats the write.
- `remove_competitor` (competitors:write, destructive): Stops watching a competitor page. Changes already found stay in the history. idempotencyKey is any unique string you choose per action; retrying with the same key never repeats the write.
- `update_case_status` (cases:write, destructive): Moves a brand protection case to a new status (for example documented, confirmed, escalated, resolved or closed), following the same allowed steps as the dashboard. Escalating, resolving and closing need a role that can escalate. idempotencyKey is any unique string you choose per action; retrying with the same key never repeats the write.
